verdict.rationale: Casium's only RFE evidence is a pricing line saying there are "No RFE or assessment fees." That implies RFE response work is covered under its attorney-led service, but it is a single thin mention, not documentation of the work itself. Missing for 10: a description of the RFE response process, any mention of NOID handling, details of who drafts responses and on what timelines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RFE outcomes.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings

citations.quote: No billable hours. No RFE or assessment fees
